# Neo-Vulpkanin
Neo-Vulpkanins played a large role in the current naming scheme of all Neocytes, and it wasn't really even intetional on their part. Once contact was established between Humanity and Vulpkanins, ideas of transhumanism naturally flowed between the two species and culminated into the first inter-species transhumanist group, which would then quickly take on other members as more species were discovered.
## Resistances - Receive [color=#ffa500]25% more heat damage[/color], [color=#8147ff]25% more shock damage[/color], and [color=#FF3636]10% more blunt damage[/color]. - Receive [color=#1e90ff]55% less cold damage[/color].
